bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
sha=0b276e9c0663db2e1a7c2ffb692c9012d62924bd
git fetch --no-tags origin "$sha" >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 65
stage="$(mktemp -d)"
chmod 700 "$stage"
trap 'rm -rf "$stage"' EXIT
git show "$sha:scripts/publish_missing_normal_topic_buttons.py" > "$stage/normal.py"
python3 -B "$stage/normal.py" --mode apply --group category --page 0
python3 -B "$stage/normal.py" --mode apply --group area --page 0
python3 -B "$stage/normal.py" --mode apply --group area --page 9
